'''Byeong Chun Lee''' ({{Korean|hangul=이병천}}; born January 5, 1965), also spelled '''Lee Byeong-chun''', is the veterinary professor at [[Seoul National University]]<ref name="msnbc 16269771">{{cite web
| url=  http://www.nbcnews.com/id/16269771
| archive-url=  https://web.archive.org/web/20180407201459/http://www.nbcnews.com/id/16269771/
| url-status=  dead
| archive-date=  April 7, 2018
| title=  Disgraced scientist says he cloned female dog 
| publisher=  [[NBC News]]/[[Associated Press]]
| date=  1 July 2007 
| access-date = 31 August 2010
}}</ref><ref name="SNU">{{cite web|title=Byeong-Chun LEE, DVM, PhD Professor|url=http://vet.snu.ac.kr/eng/html/academics/faculty/custom_14001/index.jsp|website=Seoul National University College of Veterinary Medicine website|access-date=27 February 2016}}</ref> responsible for the ₩300 million [[South Korean won|KRW]] (about US$240,000) "[[Toppy]]" dog cloning program in 2007.<ref name="Alexi Mostrous">{{cite news  
| last=  Mostrous 
| first=  Alexi 
| url=  http://www.timesonline.co.uk/tol/news/world/article3814810.ece
| archive-url=  https://web.archive.org/web/20080706180047/http://www.timesonline.co.uk/tol/news/world/article3814810.ece
| url-status=  dead
| archive-date=  July 6, 2008
| title=  Seven cloned sniffer dogs named Toppy begin training in South Korea
| publisher=  [[The Sunday Times]] 
| date=  April 25, 2008
| access-date= 31 August 2010}}</ref> Yi is a former aide to [[Hwang Woo-suk]], a pioneer in the field with the "[[Snuppy]]" clone, who fell from grace after his [[stem cell]] research turned out to have been fabricated.<ref name="Hyung-Jin Kim">{{cite news  
| last=  Kim
| first=  Hyung-Jin 
| url=  https://www.theguardian.com/science/2008/apr/25/genetics.korea
| title=  Cloned sniffer dogs go on show
| work=  [[The Guardian]]
| date=  25 April 2008
| access-date= 31 August 2010}}</ref> Yi has been described as "one of the world's best-known dog cloning experts."<ref name="Kim So-hyun">{{cite news  
| last=  Kim 
| first=  So-hyun
| url=  http://www.asianewsnet.net/news.php?id=707&sec=1
| title=  Scandal brews over American owner of cloned puppies
| publisher=  [[The Korea Herald]]/Asia News Network 
| date=  2008-08-08
| access-date= 2010-08-31}}</ref>
